PLUGIN_MANIFEST_NOT_FOUND.zh-CN: 插件包缺少 plugin.json，请重新安装完整插件包。
PLUGIN_MANIFEST_NOT_FOUND.en-US: The plugin package is missing plugin.json. Reinstall the complete plugin package.

PLUGIN_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_FAIL.zh-CN: 插件清单格式不符合规范，请联系插件作者重新打包。
PLUGIN_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_FAIL.en-US: The plugin manifest does not match the schema. Ask the plugin author to repackage it.

PLUGIN_SIGNATURE_NOT_FOUND.zh-CN: 插件包缺少 signature.bin，当前包可能未签名。
PLUGIN_SIGNATURE_NOT_FOUND.en-US: The plugin package is missing signature.bin and may be unsigned.

PLUGIN_SIGNATURE_FAIL.zh-CN: 插件签名校验失败，插件可能已被篡改。
PLUGIN_SIGNATURE_FAIL.en-US: Plugin signature verification failed. The plugin may have been tampered with.

PLUGIN_FILES_DIGEST_FAIL.zh-CN: 插件文件摘要不一致，插件内容可能已被修改。
PLUGIN_FILES_DIGEST_FAIL.en-US: Plugin file digest mismatch. The plugin content may have been modified.

PLUGIN_CUSTOMER_MISMATCH.zh-CN: 插件客户码与当前授权不一致，无法加载。
PLUGIN_CUSTOMER_MISMATCH.en-US: The plugin customer code does not match the current license.

PLUGIN_CUSTOMER_HMAC_FAIL.zh-CN: 插件客户绑定校验失败，请联系主作者重新签名。
PLUGIN_CUSTOMER_HMAC_FAIL.en-US: Plugin customer binding verification failed. Ask the master signer to re-sign it.

PLUGIN_LICENSE_INVALID.zh-CN: 当前授权无效，插件未加载。
PLUGIN_LICENSE_INVALID.en-US: The current license is invalid. The plugin was not loaded.

PLUGIN_FEATURE_DISABLED.zh-CN: 当前授权未开通插件功能。
PLUGIN_FEATURE_DISABLED.en-US: The current license does not enable plugin features.

PLUGIN_MAIN_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.zh-CN: 插件不支持当前主程序版本，请升级主程序或更换插件版本。
PLUGIN_MAIN_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.en-US: This plugin does not support the current host version. Upgrade the host or use another plugin version.

PLUGIN_LOAD_TIMEOUT.zh-CN: 插件加载超时，已自动跳过。
PLUGIN_LOAD_TIMEOUT.en-US: Plugin loading timed out and was skipped.

PLUGIN_RUNTIME_ERROR.zh-CN: 插件运行时出错，主程序已隔离该错误。
PLUGIN_RUNTIME_ERROR.en-US: The plugin raised a runtime error. The host isolated the failure.

PLUGIN_HOOK_ERROR.zh-CN: 插件 Hook 执行失败，主流程已继续。
PLUGIN_HOOK_ERROR.en-US: A plugin hook failed. The main workflow continued.

PLUGIN_QUARANTINED.zh-CN: 插件连续失败次数过多，已被隔离。
PLUGIN_QUARANTINED.en-US: The plugin failed too many times and has been quarantined.
